title: Add geolocation capture to service report submission

requirements.text: Extend the backend DailyServiceReport data model to store optional geolocation captured at report submission time, and persist it with each report.

quotes: want to add geo location for report submission.

acceptanceCriteria: DailyServiceReport includes optional geolocation fields (at minimum latitude and longitude; may also include accuracy and captured timestamp) without breaking report creation for users who do not grant location permission.
createReport stores the submitted geolocation (when provided) and continues to set createdBy to the caller as it does today.
listReports, getReportById, and getReportsForDownload return geolocation fields as part of the report payload.

requirements.text: Add a conditional state migration for existing deployments so previously stored reports remain readable after adding the new geolocation fields.

quotes: want to add geo location for report submission.

acceptanceCriteria: A backend migration is provided (per the project migration policy) that upgrades existing stored DailyServiceReport entries by initializing new geolocation fields to null/none.
After upgrade, existing reports can still be listed and viewed without traps or decoding errors.

requirements.text: Update the report submission UI to capture the user’s current geolocation using the browser geolocation API and include it in the report payload when submitting.

quotes: want to add geo location for report submission.

acceptanceCriteria: ReportEntryPage includes a clearly labeled geolocation section (e.g., “Location”) with a control to capture/refresh location and an indicator showing whether location is attached to the report.

If the user denies permission, location is unavailable, or the request times out, the report can still be submitted successfully without location and the UI shows a clear, non-blocking error message in English.
When location capture succeeds, the submitted report includes the captured latitude/longitude (and any additional captured fields) sent to the backend via useCreateReport.
No changes are made to frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.

requirements.text: Display captured geolocation on report viewing surfaces and include it in CSV exports.

quotes: want to add geo location for report submission.

acceptanceCriteria: ReportDetailPage displays location information when present (e.g., latitude/longitude and accuracy if available) and hides the section when not present.
CSV download (frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts) includes additional column(s) for geolocation, leaving values blank when a report has no location.
Existing report history browsing and filtering continues to work without runtime errors after the DailyServiceReport type changes.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; only add backend/migration.mo if required for upgrade compatibility.

Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx (compose around them instead).
Use English for all user-facing UI strings.
nonGoals: Implementing map views, reverse geocoding, or address lookup.
Adding third-party location services, GPS/map SDKs, or external databases.
Adding real-time location tracking; only capture location for report submission.
